term.title: component

definitions.text: Constituent whose amount or concentration can be varied independently in a mixture.

notes.1: The number of components in a given system is the minimum number of independent species necessary to define the composition of all phases of that system. Relations among the constituents, such as charge balance or chemical equilibria, must be taken into account in determining the number of components. The term "component" is also often used in the more general sense defined under constituent.

sources: PAC, 2008, 80, 233. 'Glossary of terms related to solubility (IUPAC Recommendations 2008)' on page 241 (https://doi.org/10.1351/pac200880020233)
